title: Hybrid networking — VPN, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink
topic: Site-to-Site VPN vs Direct Connect, DX+VPN failover, Transit Gateway hub-spoke, VPC peering non-transitive routing, PrivateLink vs VPC endpoints, on-prem to Night 9 VPC scenarios
format: 15 timed scenario questions (~24 min, ~96 sec each). Reinforces night-21-hybrid-networking.md. Theory night — no lab deploy. Answer without peeking at night-21-quiz-answers.json first.
answerDistribution: A×4 B×4 C×4 D×3 — options shuffled so correct letter varies

questions.question: Resort HQ (192.168.0.0/16) must reach saa-study-gsa-vpc (10.0.0.0/16) this week over the public internet with encrypted tunnels. No dedicated fiber yet. Fastest AWS hybrid option?

options.A: AWS Site-to-Site VPN — IPSec to a virtual private gateway or Transit Gateway
options.B: AWS Direct Connect with a 10 Gbps dedicated port ordered this week for this workload
options.C: VPC peering between the data center LAN CIDR and the VPC CIDR for this workload
options.D: AWS PrivateLink interface endpoint installed in the on-prem rack for this workload

questions.question: Leadership requires consistent sub-10 ms jitter and 5 Gbps sustained throughput from on-prem ETL to Aurora in private subnets. Public internet variability is unacceptable. Primary link?

options.B: AWS Direct Connect private virtual interface to the VPC or Transit Gateway
options.A: Site-to-Site VPN with accelerated VPN as the only hybrid path for this workload
options.C: NAT Gateway in the public subnet with port forwarding to Aurora for this workload
options.D: Internet Gateway attached to the database subnet route table for this workload

questions.question: You already have Direct Connect as the primary hybrid path. The exam asks for resilience when the DX circuit fails. Standard companion service?

options.C: Site-to-Site VPN as backup terminating on the same Transit Gateway or VGW
options.A: Replace DX with a second Internet Gateway attached to the VPC for this workload
options.B: VPC peering to a second Direct Connect location in another Region for this workload
options.D: Public VIF only — drop the private VIF during DX circuit outages for this workload

questions.question: Twelve VPCs across three accounts must all reach on-prem 172.16.0.0/12 and a shared inspection VPC. Full mesh VPC peering is rejected. Hub design?

options.D: Transit Gateway with attachments per VPC and centralized route tables
options.A: One Site-to-Site VPN per VPC to duplicate customer gateway devices
options.B: PrivateLink interface endpoint in every spoke VPC for each resource for this workload
options.C: Inter-Region VPC peering only — with no hybrid on-prem connectivity

questions.question: VPC A peers with VPC B. VPC B peers with VPC C. Apps in VPC A must reach RDS in VPC C by private IP. Will peering alone work?

options.A: No — VPC peering is non-transitive; need A↔C peering or a Transit Gateway path
options.B: Yes — peering is transitive across three VPCs automatically by default for this workload
options.C: Yes — if all three VPCs are configured with the same CIDR block for this workload
options.D: No — peering only works when all VPCs are in one AWS account for this workload

questions.question: A third-party ski-analytics API runs in the vendor's AWS account. Your Fargate tasks in saa-study-gsa-vpc must call it without traversing the public internet. Vendor offers AWS PrivateLink. Pattern?

options.B: Interface VPC endpoint in your subnets to the vendor NLB endpoint service
options.A: Site-to-Site VPN from your VPC to the vendor's corporate office network
options.C: VPC peering between 10.0.0.0/16 and the vendor VPC with merged routes
options.D: S3 Gateway endpoint in the private subnet route table for the API for this workload

questions.question: Fargate tasks in Night 9 private subnets upload pipeline artifacts to S3 without NAT charges for that traffic. Which Night 8 pattern still applies — not PrivateLink to a third party?

options.C: S3 Gateway VPC endpoint associated with the private subnet route table
options.A: AWS PrivateLink to a partner-published S3 endpoint service elsewhere
options.B: Direct Connect public VIF as the only supported option for S3 access
options.D: Client VPN attached on each Fargate task ENI for S3 uploads for this workload

questions.question: On-prem and AWS both use 10.0.0.0/16. You attempt Site-to-Site VPN to saa-study-gsa-vpc. BGP never installs usable routes. Root cause?

options.D: Overlapping CIDR blocks — hybrid routing cannot distinguish identical prefixes
options.A: VPN requires exactly one tunnel — delete the second tunnel immediately for this workload
options.B: Virtual private gateway must be placed in a public subnet to work for this workload
options.C: Direct Connect is mandatory whenever on-prem and VPC CIDRs match for this workload

questions.question: Direct Connect private VIF terminates on a Direct Connect Gateway. Multiple VPCs in us-east-1 must receive on-prem routes. Common next hop from DX Gateway?

options.A: Transit Gateway — DX Gateway associates with TGW for multi-VPC hybrid hub
options.B: Internet Gateway attached in each VPC for on-prem route distribution
options.C: NAT Gateway in every Availability Zone as the hybrid next hop for this workload
options.D: AWS PrivateLink endpoint service published once per spoke VPC for this workload

questions.question: Compare encryption defaults on the exam. Which statement is correct?

options.B: Site-to-Site VPN uses IPSec; DX is private — add VPN over DX if encryption is
options.A: Direct Connect encrypts all traffic with IPSec by default on every VIF for this workload
options.C: Transit Gateway encrypts all inter-VPC traffic with CMKs by default for this workload
options.D: VPC peering traffic crosses the public internet unless PrivateLink is on

questions.question: Night 16 Aurora must accept PostgreSQL only from on-prem BI hosts (192.168.50.0/24) and Lambda in the same VPC — not the internet. Hybrid is already up via TGW. Security control?

options.C: Aurora security group: allow TCP 5432 from on-prem CIDR and from the Lambda SG
options.A: Enable Aurora public accessibility and restrict NACL to 192.168.50.0/24 for this workload
options.B: Attach an Internet Gateway to the DB subnet for on-prem BI traffic for this workload
options.D: Replace hybrid connectivity with CloudFront origin for port 5432 for this workload

questions.question: Two dev teams need bidirectional private IP connectivity between vpc-dev (10.2.0.0/16) and vpc-staging (10.3.0.0/16) in the same Region. No SaaS endpoint service involved. Simplest fit?

options.D: VPC peering with reciprocal routes for each other's CIDR blocks
options.A: AWS PrivateLink with staging publishing every EC2 as an endpoint service
options.B: Site-to-Site VPN between the two VPCs over the public internet
options.C: Direct Connect hosted connection between dev and staging accounts only

questions.question: A shared-services account owns a Transit Gateway. Spoke VPCs in other accounts must attach. Which AWS feature shares the TGW without moving the VPCs?

options.A: AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) share of the Transit Gateway across accounts
options.B: AWS Organizations SCP that copies Transit Gateway route tables to spokes for this workload
options.C: VPC peering from every spoke VPC to the management account only for this workload
options.D: AWS PrivateLink gateway endpoint published for the Transit Gateway for this workload

questions.question: night-21-hybrid-networking.md is a theory night with $0 deploy. What hands-on artifact should you produce tonight?

options.B: Three paper diagrams: on-prem→VPC hybrid, multi-VPC TGW hub, SaaS via
options.A: Run night-21-lab-vpn-setup.ps1 to create a customer gateway in the account
options.C: Delete saa-study-gsa-vpc to avoid NAT charges before Week 3 review
options.D: Enable Aurora public accessibility for Site-to-Site VPN testing for this workload

questions.question: Remote engineers on laptops need encrypted access to resources in saa-study-gsa-vpc — not a data-center site link. Service?

options.C: AWS Client VPN (or similar remote-access VPN) — per-user, not Site-to-Site
options.A: Site-to-Site VPN with one IPSec tunnel configured per engineer laptop
options.B: Direct Connect hosted connection provisioned for each remote engineer
options.D: VPC peering from corporate hotel Wi-Fi networks into the study VPC for this workload
